72376.sol: In a photo-diode, the dark current is the current that flows when no light is incident on it. It is essentially the reverse saturation current of the p-n junction diode. 127604.subject: Botany
127604.text: In a terrestrial ecosystem, what is the food chain that carries a larger fraction of energy?
127604.sol: In an aquatic ecosystem, GFC is the major conduit for energy flow.
